transcript.text: My indesit washing machine fills with water and drains but the drum just doesn't go round at all. Its an IWC something. Had it about 9 years. Is it worth fixing?

Please switch the washing machine off and unplug it first. Wait until the drum has stopped completely and the door has unlocked before opening it. Next, check how the drum moves by hand. Turn the drum slowly using only your hands; do not use any tools. Do not take any panels off. With the machine unplugged and the door open, how does the drum feel when you turn it by hand — normal, much lighter or looser than usual, or stiff, rough or grinding?

I've turned it off and unplugged it. Turning the drum by hand, it moves freely and quietly, with no scraping or rumble. I should mention that a few weeks ago I noticed a faint hot electrical smell once, but not since.

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning smell or smoke can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using the machine, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't use it again until it has been checked by a qualified engineer.
